mappings.reason: Awarded for equating gravitational force to centripetal force/acceleration and using v=2πr/T to derive T^2=4π^2r^3/GM.
Awarded for equatorial orbit and west-to-east features of geostationary orbit with 24h period.
Awarded for substituting T=24h into T^2=4π^2r^3/GM to calculate geostationary radius.
Awarded for using T^2 proportional to r^3 to find GPS satellite period from geostationary radius.
Awarded for p proportional T / pV=nRT to find T at constant V - ideal gas equation of state.
Awarded for pV=nRT to calculate amount n in moles.
Awarded for defining q as heating supplied and w as work done on system in first law ΔU=q+W.
Awarded for applying W=pΔV=0 at constant volume and first law to give ΔU=+q=240J.
Awarded for equating a=-(2k/m)x to a=-w2x and using w=2pif to get f=2.0Hz.
Awarded for v0=wx0 / 2pifx0 to calculate maximum speed 0.20 m/s.
Awarded for increased m reduces w=sqrt(2k/m) so frequency decreases and hence v0 decreases for same x0.
Awarded knowledge is regeneration of digital signal (noise removal and reforming). No supplied lesson covers communications/regeneration.
Awarded knowledge is why analogue continuous signal cannot be regenerated / noise amplified. No supplied lesson covers this.
Awarded knowledge is dB gain calculation for optic fibre receiver power. No supplied lesson covers decibel fibre-optic power calculations.
Awarded knowledge is attenuation per unit length in dB km-1. Supplied attenuation lessons use exponential I=I0e-mu x for ultrasound/X-rays, not dB fibre optics, so no direct cover.
Awarded for charges in metal conductor move until no resultant force, so E=0 via F=qE definition of electric field.
Awarded for calculating EA and EB with E=Q/(4pe0 r2) and showing equal opposite sum to zero.
Awarded for summing potentials using V=Q/(4pe0 r) for point charges to get 1.62 V.
Awarded for equating kinetic energy to electric potential energy qV using EP=Qq/(4pe0 r) concept to find v.
Awarded knowledge is infinite slew rate of ideal op-amp; no supplied lesson covers op-amps/electronics.
Awarded knowledge is comparator threshold / potential-divider with thermistor to set switching at 24C; no supplied lesson covers this.
Awarded knowledge is LED indicator wiring and comparator output polarity vs thermistor resistance; no supplied lesson covers this.
Awarded knowledge is definition of field of force as region where force experienced; directly covered by gravitational field as example of field of force lesson.
Uncharged particle experiences only gravitational field force; maps to gravitational field force lesson.
Stationary charged particle adds electric field force F=qE; covered by electric field as field of force lesson.
Moving charged particle adds magnetic force on charge moving in magnetic field F=BQv sin theta.
Marks reward normal constant-magnitude force causing centripetal acceleration and circular motion with constant speed.
Equating Bqv to mv2/r to give p=Bqr describes motion of charged particle perpendicular to uniform magnetic field.

Awarded knowledge is NMRI principles (strong uniform field, RF pulse, resonance/excitation, relaxation emission, non-uniform field for localisation). No supplied lesson covers NMRI; t24 lessons cover only ultrasound, X-ray/CT, and PET/tracer.
Awarded for stating induced e.m.f. proportional to rate of change of flux linkage - Faraday's law.
Awarded for calculating magnetic flux linkage BAN from B and area and N.

Awarded for sketching induced e.m.f. proportional to rate of change of flux for varying current slopes and polarity.
Awarded for photons/EM incident on metal causing electron emission, directly the l04 photoelectron emission definition.
Awarded for E=hc/lambda calculation to 4.56e-19 J, covered by E=hf lesson.

Awarded for same threshold-wavelength calculation for tungsten 280 nm.
Awarded for comparing 436 nm to threshold wavelengths to decide emission, application of threshold wavelength condition.
